from cyhole.jupiter import Jupiter
from cyhole.jupiter.client import GetSwapOrderParams, PostSwapExecuteBody
from cyhole.core.token.solana import SOL, USDC

# Initialize Jupiter client
jupiter = Jupiter()
client = jupiter.client

# Define swap parameters for SOL to USDC
swap_params = GetSwapOrderParams(
    inputMint=SOL.address,
    outputMint=USDC.address,
    amount=int(1e9),  # 1 SOL in lamports
)

# Get swap quote (order)
quote_response = client.get_swap_order(swap_params)
print(f"Quote received: {quote_response}")

# Execute the swap using the quote
execute_body = PostSwapExecuteBody(
    quoteResponse=quote_response,
)

execute_response = client.post_swap_execute(execute_body)
print(f"Swap executed: {execute_response}")
